checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does verify_data_column_sidecar reject sidecars with mismatched array lengths for column, kzg_commitments, and kzg_proofs?

reachability.notes: An attacker sends a sidecar with mismatched array lengths. Without this check, KZG batch verification would access out-of-bounds elements.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the verify_data_column_sidecar function in the P2P gossip validation pipeline. 2. Locate where column, kzg_commitments, and kzg_proofs arrays are accessed. 3. Verify that an explicit length equality check exists BEFORE any batch verification or array indexing occurs. 4. Craft test sidecars with mismatched lengths: (a) column.len=5, commitments.len=3, proofs.len=4 (b) column.len=0, commitments.len=1, proofs.len=1 (c) column.len=128, commitments.len=127, proofs.len=128. 5. Submit these malformed sidecars via P2P and verify they are rejected with an appropriate error BEFORE reaching verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch. 6. Confirm no crash, panic, or out-of-bounds access occurs. 7. Check error messages do not leak internal state information.
checklist.falsification_vector: Send a DataColumnSidecar over P2P with intentionally mismatched array lengths (e.g., 5 columns, 3 commitments, 4 proofs). If the node crashes, exhibits undefined behavior, silently accepts the sidecar, or processes it through verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch, the property is falsified.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0016, Trust Boundary: tb-001, Invariant: p2p:SG-002:INV-004. CRITICAL: Attacker-controlled input at P2P boundary. Mismatched array lengths could cause out-of-bounds access in KZG batch verification, potentially leading to crash (DoS) or incorrect proof acceptance (consensus corruption). PoC guidance: send sidecar with column.len=5, commitments.len=3, proofs.len=4.
